attributes.mechanism: Exactly three production words differ: +0x28 target 'add r30,r31,r0', ours 'add r3,r31,r0'; +0x2c target 'addi r30,r30,3608', ours 'addi r30,r3,3608'; +0x30 target 'lwz r3,524(r30)', ours 'lwz r3,4132(r3)'. The extra3608 is forwarded into the first load's displacement. Turning peephole off preserves the524 load, locating this address rewrite in the peephole-enabled pipeline; it does NOT prove a particular internal compiler function or global source impossibility. Its other differences show why merely disabling that pass is insufficient.
